integrity_notes: Analytical infinite-parameter proof with an explicit marginal-preserving optimal coupling; independently compared with finite full-distribution linear programs. Neither computational samples nor a literature search alone certify infinite truth or novelty.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for k unit-cost projects with identical marginals and one exceptional project with cost 1<c<k; no ex-post utility or voter fairness condition; optimizes strict overbudget probability under a hard overspend cap, not expected overshoot or welfare. Priority against unindexed equivalent formulas remains uncertain.
title: A harmonic staircase for overbudget risk in BB1 project lotteries
